notes.title: FORKLIFT FLOWERPOT Demo Update in Turn-Based Carnival
notes.notes:
We're so excited to be a part of the Turn-based carnival with an update to the Tomato Fighters turn-based card game - the tomato gods didn't want me to share the instruction booklet with you on Steam before the showcase, but I figured I could get away with this. They're just fictional characters, right?

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42647533/16058a1767a8c8307880562df04035d711f971d2.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42647533/16058a1767a8c8307880562df04035d711f971d2.gif[/img][/url]

[h3]HOW TO PLAY
[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Action Phase[/b] - Draw and play 5 cards. Cards can give your character resources or alter the terrain where your flowerpot is on the board . Switch between your hand and the board to carefully execute your plan.
[*] [b]Draft Phase[/b] - use your resources (banked rain tokens) to purchase new cards for your deck.
[*] [b]Scoring Phase[/b] - A random tile is chosen for scoring. If a player owns the tile, they gain 1 point along with the modifiers on that tile. For each round number, an additional tile is scored, ramping up the stakes. If able, the scoring tile will have +1 tomato token added to it after scoring.
[/list]


[h3]RESOURCES
[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Wind[/b] - allows a player to move their flowerpot one space on the board.
[*] [b]Rain[/b] - claims an untaken space, adds to banked rain token when played on a space you already own.
[*] [b]Blight token[/b]- Adds a blight token to this space. Blight scores -1 for the player owner and will replace any tomato tokens on the tile.
[*] [b]Tomato token[/b]- Scores +1 tomato for the player owner. Can not replace a blight tile.
[/list]


[h3]ADVANCED TECHNIQUES
[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Holding Tokens [/b]- Tokens can be held by pressing the action button in board mode. They do not score points when held.
[*] [b]Blight Stacking [/b]- stack a bunch of blight together and drop it on your opponent for devastation
[*] [b]Tomato Stacking [/b]- steal and acquire tomatoes and stack them on your own tiles for potential quick wins.
[*] [b]Resource Hoarding [/b]- all resources persist between rounds. Go ahead, save your rain drops for a big purchase. Save your wind to drop a huge blight stack on your opponent.
[/list]


See you during the event with another livestream :)
